# BlueMind

> BlueMind is AI-powered compliance and practice management software for financial advisors, insurance agencies, MGAs and insurance carriers in Canada and the US. One platform, three solutions: BlueMind Advisor for individual advisors, BlueMind Enterprise for firms that supervise advisors, and partnerships for insurance carriers.

Key facts:
- Category: compliance software / regtech for life insurance and financial advice.
- Regulators covered: FSRA (Canada), SEC and FINRA (US). Covers KYC, suitability, record-keeping and audit trail.
- Mia is BlueMind's AI assistant: it joins client meetings (with client consent), drafts notes and forms, runs compliance checks and prepares follow-ups. Nothing is filed or sent without the advisor's sign-off.
- Works with the calendar and email advisors already use (Google Calendar, Gmail and others).
- Pricing (BlueMind Advisor): Pro $79 CAD per user per month; Team $169 CAD per month for 2 users, $59 per additional user; Enterprise custom. There is no free plan.
- Founded by a CFP; built by advisors, for advisors.
- Offices: 3601 Hwy 7, Suite 610, Markham, ON L3R 0M3, Canada; 127 West 26th St., Suite 500, New York, NY 10001, USA.
- Contact: +1 888 887 5707, support@bluemind.app, https://bluemind.app/contact.html

- [BlueMind — AI compliance software for insurance and financial advisors](https://bluemind.app/): BlueMind is AI-powered compliance and practice management software for advisors, agencies and carriers in the financial and insurance industry, in Canada and the US.
- [BlueMind Advisor — AI compliance assistant for financial advisors](https://bluemind.app/advisor.html): Invisible compliance for advisors: BlueMind takes notes, fills forms, checks KYC and suitability and keeps an audit-ready file, so you spend your time on clients instead of admin.
- [BlueMind Enterprise — compliance oversight for insurance firms and agencies](https://bluemind.app/enterprise.html): Grow your distribution, not your risk. BlueMind Enterprise gives compliance teams a live view of every advisor, AI risk detection and audit-ready evidence on top of your back office.
- [Mia — the AI assistant for advisor compliance work — BlueMind](https://bluemind.app/mia.html): Mia sits in on your client meetings, fills in the paperwork and comes back with a regulator-ready file. An AI assistant built for financial and insurance advisors.
- [BlueMind for insurance carriers — reach advisors at the moment of advice](https://bluemind.app/carriers.html): Partner with BlueMind to reach advisors where the advice happens, receive complete applications and see the suitability record behind every policy.
